extensionDescription.message: Filter YouTube videos and sections and organize subscriptions into custom categories.

optionsDescription.message: Fine-tune how SimpleTube hides distractions, filters videos by length or views, and organizes subscriptions. Changes save automatically on supported YouTube pages.

feedbackDescription.message: Using the extension regularly? Share feedback, leave a rating, or suggest improvements.

generalOptionsDescription.message: Hide common distractions in feeds and subscription views without changing YouTube account data or history.

hideWatchedTitle.message: Hide watched videos from feed lists

hideWatchedHelp.message: Videos with a visible watched progress bar are removed from supported lists so you mainly see unwatched items.

hideShortsTitle.message: Hide Shorts shelves in page content

hideShortsHelp.message: Shorts rows and shelves are removed from supported feeds without disabling YouTube's Shorts navigation.

hideExpandableHelp.message: Removes expandable recommendation blocks on subscription surfaces so lists are easier to scan.

videoLengthDescription.message: Choose a minimum and maximum video length, then fade or hide videos outside that range.

applyLengthHelp.message: Compares each supported video duration to the minimum and maximum values below.

minimumLengthHelp.message: Videos shorter than this value are treated as out of range.

maximumLengthHelp.message: Videos longer than this value are treated as out of range.

outsideRangeHelp.message: Fade keeps out-of-range videos visible but dimmed; Hide removes them from the layout.

hideIsStricter.message: Impact: Hide is stricter than Fade.

videoViewsDescription.message: Choose a preferred view-count range, then fade or hide videos outside that range.

applyViewsHelp.message: Compares visible view counts with the minimum and maximum values below.

minimumViewsHelp.message: Videos below this visible view count are treated as out of range.

maximumViewsHelp.message: Videos above this visible view count are treated as out of range.

unrecognizedViewsImpact.message: Impact: unrecognized YouTube view formats are left unchanged.

enableCategoriesHelp.message: Shows category filters on subscriptions and category selectors on supported channel lists.

categoryHelp.message: Creates a category used in subscription filters and channel assignments.

deleteCategoryImpact.message: Impact: deleting a category also removes assignments from channels using it.

confirmDelete.message: Delete “$1”? $2 channel assignment(s) will also be removed.

resetDescription.message: Reset filter options to their defaults while keeping category names and channel assignments.

minimumBelowMaximum.message: Minimum must be less than maximum.
